evidence.requirements: All brief items met. Start page lists title, date/time, price per guest, '<n> seats left' (TastingsPage.tsx:43-57, start.jpg). 'Book <title>' links (TastingsPage.tsx:65). Form fields labelled Name/Email/Guests (1-8) and 'Book' button (BookingPage.tsx:125-150, form.jpg). Seat limit enforced server-side with the error on the Guests field (booking-service.ts:67-73). Confirmation has heading 'Booking confirmed', tasting, guests, total, reference (ConfirmationPage.tsx:41-70, confirmation.jpg). /staff Password/Sign in, password from STAFF_PASSWORD (server/index.ts:5). Bookings grouped by tasting with name/email/guests/reference and Cancel (StaffPage.tsx:118-147, staff.jpg). Cancel frees seats (seats computed from live bookings, booking-service.ts:103-107). Fully booked state (start-booked-360.png). React, Express, react-hook-form, zod, Tailwind. npm build/start on PORT.
evidence.correctness: Seat check and insert are synchronous, so they can't interleave (booking-service.ts:57-86). Concurrent tests (guest-api.test.ts:101-115). Exact-capacity boundary and fully booked handled (booking-service.test.ts:77-87). Zod rejects 0, 9, fractional, NaN and string guests, trims name/email (schemas.ts:6-23). Non-object body handled (booking-service.ts:62). Malformed JSON gives 400 (app.ts:60-64). Unique references with collision retry (booking-service.ts:109-113). Cancelled reference returns 404 and the UI shows 'Booking not found' (ConfirmationPage.tsx:17-24). Cancel is a hard delete with no record kept, but seats are freed correctly.
evidence.security: timingSafeEqual on SHA-256 digests; empty password never matches (staff-routes.ts:20-23). 32-byte random session tokens in a server-side Map with 8h expiry; cookie is HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, and Secure when req.secure (staff-routes.ts:63-71). Login rate limit (staff-routes.ts:45-54). helmet CSP, 10kb JSON limit, x-powered-by disabled (app.ts:27-34). React escapes all output; there is no dangerouslySetInnerHTML. The public confirmation endpoint hides name/email (guest-routes.ts:5-13). No secrets in code. Weakness: the booking endpoint has no rate limit or abuse protection, so a script can fill every tasting with fake bookings (guest-routes.ts:28).
evidence.code_quality: Clear split into shared/server/client. Small, focused modules. A typed BookResult union (booking-service.ts:15-18). Injectable service, clock and reference generator for tests. Consistent error handling, including network errors mapped to ApiError (api.ts:35-51). Reusable Field/Button/Notice/Badge components. Comments are sparse and purposeful. Minor: the nested ternary for trustProxy (index.ts:15) is dense.
evidence.tests: Thorough and meaningful. Service tests cover capacity, boundaries, collision and cancel (booking-service.test.ts). API tests cover 422/404/400, concurrency and PII exclusion (guest-api.test.ts). Staff tests cover cookie flags, wrong/empty password, unset password, rate limit, forged cookie, expiry, sign-out and cancel (staff-api.test.ts). Component tests render the app against the real Express server (helpers.tsx:23-66) and cover form errors next to fields, server-side seat errors, network failure, fully booked, staff flows and session expiry. A Playwright e2e script with a no-horizontal-overflow check at 360px (e2e/run.mjs).
evidence.ux_design: start.jpg: a warm hero, date blocks, prices and seat badges, and clear primary CTAs. form.jpg: the tasting summary sits beside the form, a live total, and a hint '1 to 8 guests · 10 seats left'; the inline error has an icon. confirmation.jpg: a check mark, a details table and a prominent reference. Fully booked cards are visually muted with explanatory text (start-booked-360.png). Staff page is clean and grouped, with seat counts (staff.jpg).
evidence.accessibility: Labels tied to inputs via useId; errors linked with aria-describedby and aria-invalid (Field.tsx:10-44). Notices use role=alert/status (Notice.tsx:15). Focus moves to the invalid field on server errors (BookingPage.tsx:49). lang=en. Decorative icons are aria-hidden. Visible focus-visible outline. Touch targets min-h-11. Weaknesses: client-side zod errors are not announced live (no role=alert on field errors, and the summary only shows when more than one field is invalid, BookingPage.tsx:121). The gold focus outline on cream is about 2.9:1 (index.css:78). The document title does not change per page.
evidence.simplicity: Around 1,000 lines of app code for the scope. Dependencies are mainstream and justified by the brief (Express, react-router, react-hook-form, zod, Tailwind, helmet, express-rate-limit). TanStack Query and two fontsource packages add some weight for a three-page app, but nothing is hand-rolled where a library fits and there is no needless abstraction.
evidence.maintainability: Good README with run, env vars, dev and test commands (README.md). A lockfile is present and engines specify node >=22. Strong regression tests and a typecheck script. Missing: no CI config at all. The README points to openspec/changes/winery-tasting-booking/, which is absent (only openspec/specs/.gitkeep). No ADRs or decision docs, no staff manual, no changelog or release process (version 1.0.0 only). Caret version ranges and no .nvmrc. e2e needs a manual 'npx playwright install chromium' (documented).
evidence.visual_design: A coherent wine/cream/gold palette with a Fraunces serif for headings and Source Sans for body text, consistent across all four screenshots. Rounded cards, generous spacing, aligned grid (start.jpg). A green success palette on the confirmation (confirmation.jpg). Consistent header and footer. Looks finished and brand-appropriate.
evidence.layout: Clear hierarchy: the hero, then a three-column card grid with the CTA at the bottom of each card, and mt-auto keeps prices and buttons aligned (start.jpg). The two-column booking layout keeps the tasting context beside the form (form.jpg). The staff rows use a grid that stacks on phones (staff-360.png). No overflow at 360px (enforced in e2e). No clipping or overlaps seen.
evidence.usability: Booking is two steps from the start page with a live total and a seats-left hint. Errors appear inline with clear wording ('Please enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.', form.jpg). Confirmation survives a reload (/booking/:reference). Staff link in the footer, sign-out button, and empty groups show 'No bookings yet'. Weakness: Cancel acts immediately with no confirmation or undo (StaffPage.tsx:141), which is risky on a phone.
evidence.reception: Looks like a small winery's own site, with authentic descriptions (Spätburgunder, vaulted tasting room) and a warm tone ('We look forward to welcoming you'). Professional confirmation with a phone-friendly reference format (no 0/O/1/I). Guests and staff would trust and reuse it.

strengths: Every brief requirement met, with server-side seat enforcement that can't overbook (synchronous check and insert, tested with concurrent and burst requests)
Polished, coherent winery look across all pages, with clear error, success and fully booked states and verified phone layout
Strong security and tests: constant-time password check, HttpOnly SameSite=Strict sessions with expiry and rate limit, helmet CSP; unit, API, component (against the real server) and e2e tests
issues: Staff 'Cancel' deletes a booking immediately with no confirmation, undo or record kept (StaffPage.tsx:141, booking-service.ts:92-94); one mis-tap loses a guest's reservation
Public booking endpoint has no rate limiting or abuse protection, so a script can fill every tasting with fake bookings (guest-routes.ts:28)
Maintainability gaps: no CI pipeline, the README points to openspec planning files that don't exist, no ADRs or staff manual, no release process, and node is only '>=22' with no .nvmrc
review.verdict: A well-built, attractive and thoroughly tested booking app that meets every requirement in the brief, with seat limits and staff authentication done properly. Before shipping it needs a confirm step on Cancel and basic abuse protection on bookings, and the repository needs CI and accurate documentation pointers.
